author: Lahyte
body:
Hey mods,  

Im Lahyte. Im writing to you guys today to get unban. Yes i admit i was hacking last time by using kill aura on the CTH servers. I was pissed at that time because i can't kill anyone and i decided to use hacks. After i got banned from Avicus, i regretted it a lot. I really like the gamemode in Avicus. Please give me a second chance as my ban was 1 year ago and i realised my mistakes. i will never use hacks again. Sorry and i hope i get unbanned
